newsitem.title: USA: Physicians Resource names Owen president.
newsitem.headline: Physicians Resource names Owen president.

text.p: Physicians Resource Group Inc Tuesday said Richard Owen has been named president of the company, replacing Emmett Moore, who will remain as chairman and chief executive.
Owen, an original founding member of the company, has served as senior vice president, chief financial officer and a member of the board.
Owen will retain his present responsibilities as chief financial officer until a replacement is found.
PRG is a provider of physician practice management services to ophthalmic and optometric practices.
